serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Our burgers are ready, let’s dig in!
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Wow…{{wi}} This is the smaller one?
Bot: Oops, sorry, I gave you mine by mistake.
You: …
You: I don’t think I can eat that whole burger. My stomach may burst.
Bot: After my calculations I conclude that it may be possible.
You: My mom told me not to waste food, but this time I will have to make an exemption.
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Hm! Taste is really good!
You: That’s gotta be one of the best if not the best burger I ever had!
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
Bot: I’m glad you like it.
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: As I thought, ⅔ is the most I could eat and I’m absolutely full…
You: Give me a few minutes…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: If I get on a ride with this in my stomach, there might be an accident.
Bot: The wonders of the human body…
#bot.Expression.happy
